gold.question: A trader concludes a distance contract covered by Directive 2011/83/EU but never gives the consumer the withdrawal information required by Article 6(1)(h). When does the withdrawal period expire?
gold.reference_answer: It expires 12 months from the end of the initial withdrawal period determined under Article 9(2).
key_facts: 1. If the trader has not provided the consumer with the information on the right of withdrawal as required by point (h) of Article 6(1), the withdrawal period shall expire 12 months from the end of the initial withdrawal period, as determined in accordance with Article 9(2).

evidence.text: 1. If the trader has not provided the consumer with the information on the right of withdrawal as required by point (h) of Article 6(1), the withdrawal period shall expire 12 months from the end of the initial withdrawal period, as determined in accordance with Article 9(2).
